description: Binding-K explicit enumerator — operator-selection LP / shadow-price / primal-dual / lp-duality search for the binding operator K(𝔥) ∈ H_{3·A}(q_0) of the canonical T_w(𝔥) factorisation T_w(𝔥) = K · ⊗_i T_w(nucleon_i) from PR #610.  For each atom 𝔥, enumerates braid words in B_{3·A} restricted to the inter-nucleon generators (σ_3, σ_6, σ_3^{-1}, σ_6^{-1} for ³H/³He; σ_3, σ_3^{-1} for ²H), filters PSD-feasible (α_gap ≤ 1e-6), and ranks by |tr_M(K · constituent_product)| at H_{3·A}(q_0) — the canonical K minimises this residual.  Issue #604 deliverable 3: empirical narrowing of bindingKUniqueness from True placeholder to a concrete enumeration over a finite candidate set, with the verified candidate ready to populate the corresponding Lean class instance fields. For ²H (n_0 = 6) this confirms K = σ_3^2 (Hopf) is the shortest PSD-feasible inter-nucleon binding.

summary.framework_status: operational — restricted-generator inter-nucleon enumeration + per-block PSD filter + Markov-trace ranking + LP/SDP dual emission wired end-to-end at H_{3·A} for ²H, ³H, ³He.
summary.verdict: 3 of 3 atoms have at least one PSD-feasible inter-nucleon binding K of length ≤ L_K_max.  For ²H the shortest PSD-feasible K is σ_3^2 (the Hopf link L_H), confirming the historical Hopf-binding identification from joint-tower-sdp-h6-h9.witness.json.  For ³H / ³He the minimal generator set may be insufficient — the explicit L_{6a4} / 8_{11}-class binding involves additional adjacent-generator patterns (σ_4, σ_5, σ_7, σ_8) which are NOT enumerated here; extended-generator search is the natural follow-up.
open_items_after_this_session: Extended-generator enumeration: include σ_4, σ_5, σ_7, σ_8 in the binding-K generator set for ³H / ³He searches (needed to capture L_{6a4} and 8_{11}-class bindings).
Markov-trace stabilization comparison: prove tr_M(K · cp at H_{3·A}) = z^{3·A - n_braid} · tr_M(T_atom at H_{n_braid}) categorically, completing the structural-fingerprint match.
Lean discharge: replace the bindingKUniqueness Prop placeholder for ²H with an explicit reference to this witness's deuteron-Hopf finding (concrete-instance proof).
Symbolic-q evaluation of the inter-nucleon Wedderburn structure to discharge the categorical uniqueness theorem.

caveats: Restricted to MINIMAL inter-nucleon generators per atom (σ_3 only for ²H; σ_3, σ_6 for ³H / ³He).  This is the natural starting set — the σ_{3k} crossings represent the single-Hopf bindings between adjacent nucleon strand triples.  More elaborate bindings (e.g. L_{6a4} which links all three nucleon pairs symmetrically) require extended generators (σ_4, σ_5, σ_7, σ_8) and a larger search space.  This session ships the minimal-generator framework + the deuteron Hopf confirmation (the simplest non-trivial case).
